summary: Fifth retest completed. Backend P0 iter331 regression and static V5 test pass. Authenticated Operations mobile UI still renders zero live V5 cards because preview browser requests to core /api endpoints abort, blocking required first-card interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: `[data-testid^='operation-card-v5-main-']` count remains 0 after manager login on /operations at mobile widths, so additional-info/full-details/more-actions/collection checks cannot execute on a real card.

integration_issues.flow: Login -> Operations data loading on preview
integration_issues.issue: Browser automation console shows repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` for same-origin APIs including `/api/operations?limit=200` and `/api/accounts`, leaving operations UI without rendered cards.

action_items: Investigate preview browser/edge abort source for same-origin `/api/*` calls (notably `/api/operations` and `/api/accounts`) before UI card validation can proceed.

After abort issue is fixed, rerun required live checks on first V5 card: additional-info toggle, full-details toggle, more-actions menu actions, and collection button existence without executing payment.
Validate that new fetch→XHR fallback path actually completes in preview automation context when fetch aborts.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/src/pages/Operations.jsx` remains very large and multi-concern, increasing blast radius for small networking changes and making card-load RCA harder.
Current fallback still does not produce rendered cards in preview automation despite backend endpoint health, indicating unresolved runtime transport/edge behavior outside business logic.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (login + static V5 + mobile overflow passed; live V5 interactions blocked by zero rendered cards)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Manager login succeeded and /operations route loaded on mobile 320/390/430 with no horizontal overflow. However operations grid/card selectors were absent, and console log captured repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` on core same-origin `/api/*` endpoints. Backend probes still confirm operations endpoint returns data.
rca of the issue: Repro: login as manager -> open /operations (320/390/430) -> no `[data-testid^='operation-card-v5-main-']` cards. Evidence: console log contains repeated aborted same-origin requests (`/api/operations?limit=200`, `/api/accounts`, `/api/vehicles`, `/api/users`, etc.). Backend regression and direct operations probe pass, so root cause remains preview browser/edge request lifecycle instability rather than OperationCard V5 static structure or backend business logic.
